name: Dancing Every Night
author: Docteurbob
description:
A community rhythm game in the spirit of osu!. Six lanes on two arcs, taps, holds, double notes and scratches, with 3 official songs.
New in 1.0: the in-game LIBRARY. Browse the online song catalogue from the game, see what you already own and install community songs with one button (Wi-Fi needed).
Make your own songs with the free online editor: https://dancing-every-night.pages.dev/editor/ - songs can also be added by copying a .zip or a folder into ux0:data/dancingeverynight/import/.
Open source (GPLv3).
